observations: PlayStation 4 Slim console with a red and black graphic skin applied.
The console is wrapped in clear plastic film.
A DualShock 4 controller is shown in a box with 'Call of Duty Black Ops Cold War' branding.
A TV screen shows the PS4 dashboard with a library of 8 games including FC25, God of War, and Spider-Man: Miles Morales.
The system status on the screen indicates 'Offline'.
A watermark 'JAYCYPHER GAMES' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: The console is obscured by a decorative skin and plastic wrapping.
There is no photo of the System Information screen showing the firmware version (e.g., 9.00 or 11.00).
While the game library suggests installed PKG files, there is no photo of an exploit menu like GoldHEN.
Photo 0 shows the game library icons including EA Sports FC 25.

risks.risk: Firmware version may be updated, making it unhackable.
risks.proof: A photo of Settings > System > System Information showing the software version.

risks.risk: The controller may be a third-party clone rather than an original Sony unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the sticker on the back of the controller.
A photo of the Storage settings screen.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the console accepting, reading, and launching a physical game disc.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the System Software version.
Photo of the Storage screen showing the total HDD capacity.
Photo of the back of the controller to check the manufacturer label.
Video of the console reading a physical game disc.
response.reason: The item is clearly a PS4 Slim. It is priced at the worst case of a standard 500GB non-hacked unit with a generic controller; proof of firmware and storage would significantly increase the valuation.
